title: Arlo base station offline
fullDescription:
Arlo base station (SmartHub/Base Station) connects via Ethernet to the router. If offline, cameras dependent on it lose connectivity. Check Ethernet, power LED, and router DHCP.

Power cycle: unplug base 10s, then router 60s, reconnect router first, then base.

title: Arlo motion detection not triggering events
shortDescription: Motion events not recorded despite detected movement.
fullDescription: Arlo modes control recording. If mode is set to Disarmed, no events record. Also verify motion detection sensitivity and activity zones. Arlo Secure subscription is required for full event retention.

fixSteps.title: Check activity zones
fixSteps.instruction: Ensure zones cover area of interest.

title: Arlo live view fails to load
shortDescription: Live stream error; camera won't connect.
fullDescription: Stream failures are often caused by weak Wi-Fi (at camera or between hub and camera), congested 2.4GHz band, or low battery preserving power. Check signal in device info and camera battery level.
videoSearchQuery: Arlo live view not loading fix

title: Arlo login or 2FA fails
fullDescription: Arlo requires 2FA. Check email/SMS delivery of codes. After multiple failed attempts, account may be temporarily locked — wait 30 min. Reset password via arlo.com if needed.

title: Arlo weak Wi-Fi signal to direct cameras
shortDescription: Essential/Pro 4/5 cameras showing weak router connection.
fullDescription: Direct-to-router Arlo cameras (Essential, Pro 4/5, Ultra 2 2-camera) need strong 2.4GHz signal. Signal <-70 dBm causes dropouts. Add extender/mesh or move router closer.

fixSteps.title: Add mesh node
fixSteps.instruction: Place mesh node within 30 ft of camera.

title: Arlo firmware update stuck
shortDescription: Camera or base station firmware update won't complete.
fullDescription: Updates run in background and can take 30 min. Keep camera near hub/router and charged. If stuck >2 hours, factory reset via the sync button (hold 15s) and re-add.

fixSteps.title: Re-add camera
fixSteps.instruction: Remove from app, re-add with fresh firmware.

title: Arlo battery drains in days instead of months
shortDescription: Frequent motion events or weak signal drain battery quickly.
fullDescription: Arlo batteries last 3-6 months with moderate use. Heavy motion activity, long recordings, low Wi-Fi signal, and cold temperature reduce life. Lower sensitivity, limit clip length, and provide solar/magnetic charger for busy cameras.

title: Arlo camera won't sync to base station
shortDescription: Pairing sync between camera and base station fails.
fullDescription: Sync requires camera within 1-3 ft of base, base in sync mode (press sync button 2s, LED flashes), then camera sync within 60s. Factory reset camera if pairing is stuck.

fixSteps.title: Sync sequence
fixSteps.instruction: Press base sync 2s, then camera sync within 60s.

affectedModels: Arlo Pro, Pro 2, Pro 3, Ultra, Ultra 2

title: Arlo night vision glare or not working
shortDescription: IR reflection off glass or cobwebs; no night image.
fullDescription: IR reflects off nearby objects (windows, cobwebs, rain hood). Clean lens and surrounding area, move camera off glass. Ensure Night Vision set to On (auto).

title: Arlo features greyed out without Arlo Secure
shortDescription: Cloud recording, activity zones, and smart notifications require Arlo Secure.
fullDescription: Since 2020, most Arlo features beyond 3-day live view require Arlo Secure subscription. Sign up at arlo.com/subscription. Older devices may have grandfathered free plans.

title: Arlo Pro/Ultra base station offline
shortDescription: SmartHub or base station shows offline.
fullDescription: Arlo SmartHub uses Ethernet; offline status often comes from cable, switch, or firmware. Power-cycle the SmartHub and verify Ethernet link LED.
videoSearchQuery: Arlo security camera BASE STATION OFFLINE fix

title: Arlo single camera offline
shortDescription: One camera offline while base/hub online.
fullDescription: Camera offline means low battery, weak signal to hub, or stuck firmware. Bring camera near hub and reset.
videoSearchQuery: Arlo security camera CAMERA OFFLINE fix

title: Arlo activity zones ignored
shortDescription: Motion outside zones still triggers (or vice versa).
fullDescription: Activity Zones require Arlo Secure subscription. Without it, zones don't apply server-side. Verify subscription and zone editor.
videoSearchQuery: Arlo security camera MOTION ZONES NOT WORKING fix

title: Arlo geofencing not switching modes
fullDescription: Geofencing relies on phone location services. Background location, battery saver, or multiple users with conflicting fences cause failures.

fixSteps.title: Single decision-maker
fixSteps.instruction: Pick one user as Geofencing master.

videoSearchQuery: Arlo security camera GEOFENCING FAIL fix

title: Arlo battery dies in days
shortDescription: Pro/Ultra battery drains far faster than spec.
fullDescription: Cold temp, 4K recording, frequent live view, and Always-On power chord behavior cause heavy drain. Use solar panel or wired power if possible.

fixSteps.title: Add solar
fixSteps.instruction: Arlo Solar Panel keeps battery topped up.

videoSearchQuery: Arlo security camera BATTERY DRAIN FAST fix

title: Arlo clips not uploading
shortDescription: Motion triggered but clip missing in library.
fullDescription: Cloud upload fails when Wi-Fi at hub is congested or subscription lapsed. Some plans only retain 30 days.

fixSteps.title: Wired hub Ethernet
fixSteps.instruction: Use Ethernet rather than Wi-Fi for hub.

videoSearchQuery: Arlo security camera CLOUD RECORDING FAIL fix

title: Arlo two-way audio not working
shortDescription: Push-to-talk button works but no audio either way.
fullDescription: Mic/speaker permissions, codec mismatch, or weak signal break two-way audio. Browser tabs sometimes block mic.
videoSearchQuery: Arlo security camera TWO-WAY AUDIO FAIL fix

title: Arlo night vision dark
shortDescription: Night image is black or barely visible.
fullDescription: IR LEDs may be off, blocked by housing condensation, or set to color night mode without enough ambient light.
videoSearchQuery: Arlo security camera IR LEDS NOT WORKING fix

title: Arlo SmartHub SD card not recording
fullDescription: Local backup needs SD format and Arlo Secure plan. SmartHub VMB5000 supports microSD up to 2TB but most cards <512GB.
videoSearchQuery: Arlo security camera SD RECORDING FAIL fix

title: Arlo push notifications late
fullDescription: Phone OS battery optimization, doze mode, or notification quiet hours delay push delivery.
videoSearchQuery: Arlo security camera APP NOTIFICATIONS DELAYED fix

title: Arlo cloud library sync error 1006
fullDescription: Error 1006 indicates cloud library cursor invalidated. Often hits after retention plan downgrade or when many clips deleted at once.

title: Arlo Smart Hub VMB5000 disconnected
fullDescription: Smart Hub disconnect from cloud usually after firmware update window. Reseat Ethernet and reset.

title: Arlo Home Security System won't arm
shortDescription: All-In-One Sensor or Keypad won't arm system.
fullDescription: Arming fails when keypad battery low or sensor reports tamper. Check sensor list for any in 'open' state.

title: Arlo siren won't silence
fullDescription: Stuck siren state means hub didn't propagate disarm. Toggle siren off in app or unplug hub briefly.

title: Arlo Secure plan not covering all cameras
shortDescription: Some cameras say no cloud recording.
fullDescription: Multi-camera Secure plans cap at device count. Adding a 6th camera to a 5-cam plan disables newest.

title: Arlo Q / Q Plus end-of-life
shortDescription: Arlo Q stops connecting after April 2024.
fullDescription: Arlo Q and Q Plus reached EOL April 2024. No fix; cloud servers retired. Migrate to Pro/Essential line.

title: Arlo solar panel not charging Pro 4
shortDescription: Camera battery doesn't increase with solar attached.
fullDescription: Solar panel needs 4+ hours direct sun. Magnetic charge port can be weak. Confirm panel polarity isn't reversed (some 3rd-party).

title: Arlo Ultra 2 spotlight color night vision black
shortDescription: Color night vision shows mostly black frame.
fullDescription: Color night needs spotlight on. If spotlight is off in mode rules, color night reverts to dim B&W. Update Ultra 2 firmware to 1.20+.
symptoms: Color night enabled but no light

title: Arlo Wired Doorbell press doesn't notify
shortDescription: Pressing doorbell does nothing in app.
fullDescription: Wired doorbell notifications fail when device is connected only via 2.4GHz with very low signal, or chime kit blocking voltage.

fixSteps.title: Check signal in setup
fixSteps.instruction: Doorbell info > Wi-Fi RSSI > should be >-65.

title: Arlo activity zones max 3 per camera
fullDescription: Free Arlo Secure caps zones at 3 per camera. Premium tier raises to 6. Existing zones must be deleted to swap.
